related.title: 麥金托什壓縮空氣儲能電站
related.titleEn: McIntosh Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant
related.transfer: 可遷移「洞穴的工作氣量」與「節流到固定進氣壓力的損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；麥金托什壓縮空氣儲能電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Working gas mass of a cavern" and "Loss in throttling to constant inlet pressure" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of McIntosh Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界第一座壓縮空氣儲能電廠：兩種效率算法、壓縮溫升、節流損失、溶鹽造穴與充放比；麥金托什壓縮空氣儲能電站則以加了回熱器的第二代壓縮空氣儲能：省下的燃料、二十六小時的蓄能、往返效率與洞穴收斂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's first compressed air storage plant: two ways to count efficiency, compression heating, throttling loss, solution mining and the charge ratio; McIntosh Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant centres on second-generation compressed air storage with a recuperator: fuel saved, twenty-six hours of storage, round-trip efficiency and cavern closure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「等溫壓縮功」與「等溫壓縮功」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「往返效率的兩種算法」的模型移到麥金托什壓縮空氣儲能電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「含燃料的往返效率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Isothermal compression work" and "Isothermal compression work".
Move the model of "Two ways of counting round-trip efficiency" to McIntosh Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Round-trip efficiency including fuel", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「洞穴的工作氣量」與「節流到固定進氣壓力的損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；麥金托什壓縮空氣儲能電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Working gas mass of a cavern" and "Loss in throttling to constant inlet pressure" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of McIntosh Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant must be respecified.

related.title: 液態空氣儲能冷熱整合
related.titleEn: Liquid Air Energy Storage Heat and Cold Integration
related.transfer: 可遷移「洞穴的工作氣量」與「節流到固定進氣壓力的損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；液態空氣儲能冷熱整合的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Working gas mass of a cavern" and "Loss in throttling to constant inlet pressure" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Liquid Air Energy Storage Heat and Cold Integration must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界第一座壓縮空氣儲能電廠：兩種效率算法、壓縮溫升、節流損失、溶鹽造穴與充放比；液態空氣儲能冷熱整合則以把空氣冷成液體來存電：體積比、液化功、冷能回收、蒸發損失、餘熱再熱與低溫泵為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's first compressed air storage plant: two ways to count efficiency, compression heating, throttling loss, solution mining and the charge ratio; Liquid Air Energy Storage Heat and Cold Integration centres on storing power by chilling air to liquid: volume ratio, liquefaction work, cold recycle, boil-off, reheat with waste heat and the cryogenic pump, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「等溫壓縮功」與「液化後的體積比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「往返效率的兩種算法」的模型移到液態空氣儲能冷熱整合，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「儲槽的蒸發損失」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Isothermal compression work" and "Volume ratio on liquefaction".
Move the model of "Two ways of counting round-trip efficiency" to Liquid Air Energy Storage Heat and Cold Integration, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Boil-off from the tank", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「洞穴的工作氣量」與「節流到固定進氣壓力的損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；液態空氣儲能冷熱整合的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Working gas mass of a cavern" and "Loss in throttling to constant inlet pressure" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Liquid Air Energy Storage Heat and Cold Integration must be respecified.
